name: Shadow Dwellers – Deliverance
detailed_description:
"Ever feel like you're cut off from the world in an elevator?

...What if the doors opened, and it was a different world entirely?"

About This Game:

Shadow Dwellers – Deliverance is a 3D first-person game that fuses psychological horror with the walking simulator genre. You are a new delivery person tasked with bringing packages to the infamous "Kagesumi Apartments," a place shrouded in strange rumors.

Your job is simple: deliver packages according to your list. However, the elevator in this building sometimes connects to an "Otherworld" that will gnaw at your sanity.

This isn't a place where monsters will attack you. It's a domain where the laws of reality bend, uncanny landscapes unfold, and the familiar slowly decays into the unnerving. If you notice something is wrong—a subtle sense of unease—it's best not to linger. Return to the safety of the elevator and try again to reach your destination.

But what if your destination is a floor that doesn't exist?

Estimated Playtime

30 - 60 minutes

Features

  • [OBSERVE] A Warped Reality, A Connected Otherworld:Your mission is obstructed by the various "Otherworlds" you stumble into via the elevator. Lights flicker and die, an impossible entity looms outside, and a familiar hallway transforms into a completely alien landscape. The longer you stay, the more your sanity will fray.

  • [DECIPHER] The "Otherworld Connection": As you proceed with your deliveries, you will be forced to travel to non-existent floors. By deciphering cryptic clues hidden throughout the apartment, you can learn to willingly open a gateway to these otherworlds yourself. It is a dangerous key, but one that may lead to the truth.

  • [DELIVER] Unsettling Cargo and Enigmatic "Residents": Ominous item names and abstract instructions on the delivery slips. With each package you deliver, you'll realize the cargo itself is tied to the heart of the anomaly. And what of the things that are not quite human, standing in the corners of the hallways? Who are they, and what do they want?

  • [DEVIATE] An Alternate Ending Forged by Observation and Choice: Simply following orders will not reveal the true nature of this place. But if you have the courage to observe the world carefully and deviate from the given rules, you may forge a path to a different conclusion. Is there a true end to this bizarre chain of deliveries?

Will you see this absurd delivery route through to the very end?

Or will you resist the hopeless fate built into this place, and seize your own "Deliverance"?

short_description: A first-person psychological horror. Explore a building via an elevator to uncanny "Otherworlds." With no combat, observation is your only tool. Uncover a hidden ritual using the elevator buttons to reach impossible floors. Break the rules to find the true ending in this multi-ending adventure.
